description: GEER - M6.6 Hokkaido, Japan is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by alex grant, US Geological Survey (usgs.gov). Reconnaissance data of landslides and damages caused by liquefaction triggered by the 2018 M6.6 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi Earthquake. These data were collected as part of the GEER reconnaissance mission: 2018 M6.6 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi Earthquake to document the impacts and distribution of landslides and liquefaction following the earthquake. Coverage: Sapporo, Japan | Tomakomai, Japan | Atsuma, Japan. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Earthquakes, Landslides, Liquefaction, Housing Damage, Hokkaido, RAPID Facility. Published 2023-10-31. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
